blocks.text: Interstate Projects
blocks.textContent: Interstate Projects

blocks.text: I-75/Brent Spence Bridge Corridor - Construction of a new double-decker companion bridge adjacent to the existing Brent Spence Bridge to carry interstate and thru traffic. Project also includes improvements of approximately one mile of roadway, between the bridge approach and Linn Street, as well as a redesign and improvements to ramp configurations. Estimated Completion: 2031 (new companion bridge) and 2033 (approach work)

blocks.text: W. Pete Rose Way/Longworth Hall Building Demolition - Intermittent single-lane closure, as well as full closure on Pete Rose Way, between Smith Street/Clay Wade Bailey Bridge and Gas Alley, for ongoing building demolition. During daytime hours of operation, weekdays from approximately 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., single-lane or full closures will be in effect. Traffic will be maintained as needed by flaggers or, during periods of closure, motorists will be detoured by way of Central Avenue and Mehring Way. Estimated Completion: November 2026.

blocks.text: W. Court Street Storm/Sanitary Sewer Line & Pavement Construction - W. Court Street is reduced to one lane between Linn Street and its end near 898 W. Court. Traffic will be maintained with temporary signals, and the restriction is scheduled to be in effect through early November 2026.

blocks.text: Gest Street Water Line/Reconstruction - Gest Street is closed between Freeman Avenue and 7th Street for water line replacement as part of the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor (Phase 3) project, as well as for reconstruction as part of the Linn Street bridge replacement. The closure will be in effect through June 2030, and westbound motorists will detour via Linn Street, 8th Street and Freeman Avenue; eastbound motorists are being detoured via Freeman and 8th Street.
blocks.textContent: Gest Street Water Line/Reconstruction - Gest Street is closed between Freeman Avenue and 7th Street for water line replacement as part of the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor (Phase 3) project, as well as for reconstruction as part of the Linn Street bridge replacement. The closure will be in effect through June 2030, and westbound motorists will detour via Linn Street, 8th Street and Freeman Avenue; eastbound motorists are being detoured via Freeman and 8th Street.

blocks.text: Winchell Avenue Reconstruction - The ramp to Winchell Avenue/Ezzard Charles Drive from I-75 North, 9th Street and 6th Street is closed through May 2027 as part of the upcoming Linn Street bridge replacement/reconstruction project. There will be no signed detour for Winchell Avenue. Motorists from 9th Street to I-75 North will be detoured via 8th Street and Freeman Avenue to I-75. Access from 6th Street to Winchell will be closed with a right-lane closure on the ramp.
blocks.textContent: Winchell Avenue Reconstruction - The ramp to Winchell Avenue/Ezzard Charles Drive from I-75 North, 9th Street and 6th Street is closed through May 2027 as part of the upcoming Linn Street bridge replacement/reconstruction project. There will be no signed detour for Winchell Avenue. Motorists from 9th Street to I-75 North will be detoured via 8th Street and Freeman Avenue to I-75. Access from 6th Street to Winchell will be closed with a right-lane closure on the ramp.

blocks.text: Western Avenue Entrance Ramp Replacement - The ramp from Western Avenue to I-75 South has been closed to accommodate the maintenance of traffic plan during the Linn Street bridge replacement. This is a permanent closure, and a new ramp from Freeman Avenue to southbound I-75 will be built as part of future construction for the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor.
blocks.textContent: Western Avenue Entrance Ramp Replacement - The ramp from Western Avenue to I-75 South has been closed to accommodate the maintenance of traffic plan during the Linn Street bridge replacement. This is a permanent closure, and a new ramp from Freeman Avenue to southbound I-75 will be built as part of future construction for the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor.

blocks.text: Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 (Railroad Bridge Reconstruction) - As part of the Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 project, construction includes replacement of three railroad bridges located over Prosser Avenue, I-75, and SR 562, as well as minor realignment of I-75 lanes to accommodate new railroad bridge pier location on I-75. Lane shifts are in effect in both directions, as well as a contraflow lane for southbound traffic. Additional lane and ramp restrictions will be in effect throughout the project. Estimated Completion: Summer 2027
blocks.textContent: Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 (Railroad Bridge Reconstruction) - As part of the Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 project, construction includes replacement of three railroad bridges located over Prosser Avenue, I-75, and SR 562, as well as minor realignment of I-75 lanes to accommodate new railroad bridge pier location on I-75. Estimated Completion: Summer 2027

links.text: Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 (Railroad Bridge Reconstruction)

blocks.text:
Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8B (Pump Station & CSO) - Phase 8B is the construction of a new Pump Station and Combined Sewer Overflow for the widening of I-75. Construction is being conducted off the roadway, so there should be little to no impact to traffic associated with this project. Estimated Completion: Fall 2028

Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8C (Widening) - Phase 8C extends from Regina Graeter Way to the Galbraith Road/SR 126/RRCC interchange area and includes widening I-75 for additional through lanes and rehabilitating bridges. Traffic on I-75 North and South is being maintained in three lanes in each direction, but traffic has been shifted to the east, and a contraflow lane has been implemented on southbound I-75. Various lane and ramp restrictions will be in effect during the evening and overnight hours. Estimated Completion: Fall 2027

blocks.text: U.S. 22 (Gilbert Avenue) & I-71 Pedestrian Bridge Replacement - Construction of a new pedestrian facility connecting Mt. Adams and Cincinnati by replacing the pedestrian bridges over I-71/471 and Gilbert Avenue with the construction of a single, shared-use path bridge over the interstate and Gilbert. Throughout most of the project, the structure over I-71/471 will remain open to pedestrians, and intermittent vehicular and pedestrian traffic restrictions will be in effect. Estimated Completion: December 2026
